capabilities: Manage tasks using a file-per-task structure
Track task status through an 8-state machine
extras: The Apple Reminders sync is a DIY, self-hosted solution requiring macOS and external scripts. The plugin uses Node.js filesystem access and shell execution.
intentEvidence: Task Vault fixes the data model first: Pain | Fix
motivation: The author built it to fix the fragile data model of checklist plugins, ensuring tasks maintain stable identity and structure regardless of edits.
problem: Traditional checklist plugins treat tasks as fragile lines of text, leading to identity loss upon editing and lacking structured history or AI integration.
summary: A structured task manager for Obsidian that uses one file per task, an 8-state machine, and supports AI delegation while maintaining Markdown portability.
